subsetPolicyRationale: `s.writer.writer@1` is this plugin's own self-contained text-generation script document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (rename-writer, change-uri, change-language, edit-text, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
